mapper.insert: insert into attempt (user_id, status, question_ids, started_at) values (#{userId}, #{status}, #{questionIds}, now())
mapper.select: select * from attempt where user_id = #{userId} order by id desc limit 50
select * from attempt order by id desc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update attempt set status = 'PENDING_REVIEW', submitted_at = now() where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId} and status = 'ANSWERING'
update attempt set status = 'REVIEWED', reviewed_at = now(), reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, overall_comment = #{overallComment}, score = #{score} where id = #{id}
